title: fix(app-shell): a record page pending approval keeps one overflow menu, and a phone bar never leads with a locked Edit
body:

Fixes #35016

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：待你审批的记录页上，审批条的菜单入口不再是「··· 更多」，改为带文字的「更多审批操作 ⌄」（桌面和手机都显示文字）。三个点只留在记录标题行（手机上是底部操作栏）。手机上记录被审批锁定时，灰掉的「编辑」从底部第一个位置退到底部「···」菜单里，第一个位置让给能用的动作。
- **为什么改**：同一屏上下两个一样的三个点，用户得分别点开才知道各自装了什么；手机底部主位置被一个点不了的「编辑」占着。
- **风险与回滚**：只动控制台两处呈现，不改任何权限、请求或元数据。「通过」「拒绝」的位置和样式不变（#34361 裁决），但手机上因为右侧入口带了文字，两颗按钮各窄了约四分之一。没有审批的记录页行为不变（有测试钉住）。回滚＝还原本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 中 `sys_edit` 的一行 `phonePage && approvalLocked`（主位规则）；② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` 审批条菜单触发器；③ `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**：手机宽度（375）打开一条「待你审批」且锁定的记录：顶部审批条是「通过 / 拒绝 / 更多审批操作 ⌄」，整屏只有底部一个「···」，底部第一个按钮可点，「编辑」在「···」里且是灰的。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The approval band names its menu entry.** On the approver's band (`foldDecisions`, drawn on the record page and on the request page by `ApprovalDecisionPanel`), the menu trigger was the `⋯` glyph plus "More" (the text hidden on a phone). It is now the label "More approval actions" (zh: 更多审批操作) with a chevron, at every width, and no `⋯`. The menu holds the same levers in the same order. Approve and Reject are unchanged.
- **The record header keeps the page's one `⋯`.** On the desktop that is the header row's `⋯`. On a phone it is the bottom bar's `⋯`.
- **Phone bottom bar: a locked Edit leaves the first slot.** Under the approval lock (`resolveApprovalLock`'s `locked`), the host's Edit carries `component: 'action:menu'` on a phone page only. It goes into the bar's `⋯`, still drawn and still disabled, and the bar's queue moves up: the first usable action takes the slot. The approval band, with its 审批中已锁定 badge, states the lock. The desktop row keeps Edit greyed in place, as the card asks. A record with no approval lock gets the same Edit as before. The author's declared action order is not touched.
- **i18n: no new key.** `approvalsInbox.moreDecisionActions` already carries this label in every locale the console ships (it was the trigger's `aria-label`), so it becomes the visible text and no locale file changes. The card suggested 「其他审批操作」 as an example. Reusing the shipped key avoids a second spelling of the same entry, and the eager `locales/en.ts` stays untouched.

## Tests

Pins are added to the existing harnesses, as top-level `describe` blocks.

- `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx`, new describe "one ⋯ per screen on a record pending approval (objectstack#35016)", from a real `RecordDetailView` mount with a pending, locking request served:
  - desktop (1440): the page has exactly one `⋯` trigger (the header row's More actions), and the band's entry reads "More approval actions" with a chevron and opens Reassign, Send back, Request info;
  - phone (390), approval-locked: the bar reads [Convert Lead][Assign][More actions], its first button is enabled, the page has one `⋯`, and Edit is in the bar's menu with `aria-disabled="true"`;
  - control, no request: the bar keeps [Edit][Convert Lead][More actions] with Edit enabled, and no band entry is drawn.
- `__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.approverFold-34361.test.tsx`, new describe: the entry is its label plus a chevron, with no `⋯` glyph, and the label is not `hidden` on a phone.

The `...(phonePage && approvalLocked ? { component: 'action:menu' } : {}),` line was deleted through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 3c8368592f23 to ce38195be0ec). The suite resolves `RecordDetailView` from `src` (relative import), so no build leg was needed.

```
× phone, approval-locked: the bar's first button is pressable, and the locked Edit is in its ⋯
Tests  1 failed | 13 passed (14)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (3c8368592f23) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Only the phone-locked pin went red. The desktop pin and the no-approval control stayed green, which is expected because the rule is phone-only.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live readings**, from a showcase backend (`objectstack dev --fresh`) with this branch's console over Vite, in zh-CN, on the seeded locking request `showcase_expense_report` EXP-2001 (待你审批) and on a `showcase_project` record with no approval. Before the change: desktop band 「通过」「拒绝」「··· 更多」 and header 「编辑」(灰) 「···」, so two page `⋯`; phone band `⋯` and bottom bar [编辑(disabled)][···], so two `⋯`. After the change: desktop band 「通过」「拒绝」「更多审批操作 ⌄」 and the header's `⋯` is the only page-level `⋯`; phone band 「更多审批操作 ⌄」 and bottom bar [···] with 「编辑 (disabled)」 inside it. The no-approval record reads identically before and after at both widths: [编辑][···], with the menu 刷新 / 添加到收藏 / 分享 / 删除. Screenshots and readings were kept on the seat's project-files mount (`35016-live`).
- The showcase expense report declares no header actions of its own, so its locked phone bar is the `⋯` alone. The unit pin covers a page with declared actions taking the first slot.
- Row-level `⋯` triggers inside related tables (行操作) are per-row menus and were not counted as page menus.
- On a phone, Edit disabled for a reason other than the approval lock (a `disabledWhen` predicate, or a state that locks every field) still holds the first slot. The card scopes this to the approval lock, and the order says a record with no approval stays unchanged, so it is noted here and not changed.
